method_limits: Each raw run is accepted through br7_analysis.analyze_run, which requires PASS/is_valid and one explicitly owned, complete target trace.
Frame outcomes and durations use BR7's unique acquisition and lifecycle joins; ambiguous chains do not count as displayed or latency samples.
Acquisition-cohort outcome rates use the successful target acquisition timestamp; request-phase latency uses the unique request timestamp and a complete exact chain.
Per-phase request refresh quartiles use only BR7's full-run reference period and first positive presentedTime; zero-only phase data never supplies a local phase origin.
The refresh phase reference is descriptive and run-wide; it may not represent local refresh phase during a notification transition.
Per-phase nextDrawable stall counts use unique acquisition-cohort events and inclusive >=100ms and >=900ms thresholds.
Phase intervals are half-open [start,end); rates use observed coverage and incomplete edge windows are marked.
Target notifications are exact target telemetry timestamps. Controller action logs, when supplied, are retained separately and never time-joined.
No causal relationship is inferred from temporal proximity, and app and host clock domains are not aligned.

A pathology segment requires five contiguous full seconds at >=max(75 FPS, 1.25x highest target-reported refresh), at least 50% raw-zero callbacks and exact-zero share, at most 30 displayed cohort FPS, and at least 90% exact outcome coverage.
No process is launched, no live display is read, and no source trace is changed by this analysis.

runs.method_note: Notification timestamps and controller actions are descriptive anchors. No causal relationship is inferred; host and app clocks are not aligned. Outcome and timing metrics reuse BR7's validated target-owned frame chains.

acquisition_cohort.basis: successful target acquisitions timestamped in the phase

request_phase.basis: unique target request timestamps in the phase; latency requires an exact BR7 chain

refresh_phase.reference_scope: fixed full-run BR7 reference; never re-estimated within a notification phase
refresh_phase.reference_uncertainty: Descriptive only: a run-wide first displayed presentedTime may not represent local refresh phase during this notification interval or state transition.

window_state_observation.occlusion_semantics: window_occluded is the inverse of NSWindowOcclusionStateVisible. The bit reports whether AppKit sees any visible pixels; it does not identify a physical coverage extent or the reason pixels are not visible.
window_state_observation.sampling_interpretation: discrete target-owned telemetry samples; not continuous state proof

criteria.displayed_definition: exact BR7 chain classified as presented
criteria.zero_definition: unique target callback in the acquisition cohort with raw presented_time_mach_ns equal to zero

pathology_assessment.interpretation: Low or near-zero acquisition cannot qualify. A sustained segment requires at least max(75 FPS, 1.25 times the highest target-reported screen refresh) and at least half of acquisitions with a unique raw-zero callback, at most 30 exact displayed acquisitions per second, at least half of exact outcomes classified as zero, at least 90 percent exact-outcome coverage, and five contiguous full one-second bins. This is a run-local descriptive classifier.
